privacy_summary: This page explains which data is processed to provide the {name} experience and which choices are available to you.
privacy_purpose_text: We process only the data needed to create and manage khatms, record participation, sign in to accounts, and send the notifications you choose.
privacy_collected_account: Account information such as your name, email address, and chosen sign-in method.
privacy_collected_khatm: Information you enter to create or join a khatm, such as its title, description, and selected ranges.
privacy_collected_notifications: Notification settings and the address of a connected channel when you enable it.
privacy_collected_technical: Technical data needed for session security and service performance, such as session identifiers and browser information.
privacy_use_text: We use data to provide the service, prevent abuse, respond to support requests, and send khatm-related notifications. Notifications can be managed from your account.
privacy_sharing_text: Information you record in a public khatm may be visible to other participants in that khatm. We do not sell your personal data or share it with third parties except to provide features you choose.
privacy_control_text: You can change notification settings from your account. To request access to, correction of, or deletion of account data, contact us through the site's support section.
terms_summary: By using {name}, you confirm that you have read these terms and agree to follow them.
terms_acceptance_text: Using this system means accepting these terms and the privacy policy. If you disagree with any part, please do not use the service.
terms_use_account: Enter your account information accurately and prevent others from accessing it.
terms_use_respect: Respect other users and the spiritual nature of the service when naming and describing khatms.
terms_use_abuse: Do not use the service harmfully, send inappropriate content, or attempt to disrupt it.
terms_khatms_text: Each khatm creator is responsible for the information and invitation method used in that khatm. Recording a range indicates that you intend to read it; the service does not replace your personal commitment.
terms_availability_text: Parts of the service may change temporarily or become unavailable for maintenance, improvement, or security. We will try to communicate important changes appropriately.
terms_changes_text: These terms may be updated. The date at the top of the page shows when the text was last changed. Send questions and suggestions through the site's support section.
